issue.title: test_startup_update_toast_appears_once_in_tui fails in the full sase check lane, passes on focused retries

task_type_fields.evidence:
Proposed by sase-1m3.7.1.5 note #12 (PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP) and filed by the sase-1m3.7.1 land agent.

- FAIL: whole sase `sase tool run check` ToolRun `7bef757b7517b65fc8821fa811fddb88` on 2026-10-18 (exit 1; 56,389 passed, 33 skipped, 21 failed). This node was one of four failures with no existing KNOWN witness.
- PASS: two later focused one-worker retries (`SASE_PYTEST_WORKERS=1`) on the unchanged tree, run against both the current tree and clean primary HEAD with the pre-phase nonblank core 80dc704. No source was edited between the failure and the passing retries.
- Fail rate: 1 failure in 3 observed runs. It has only failed under the full parallel lane; it has not reproduced serially.
- Not caused by the project-stats counter change, which touches only sase-core `project_stats` and the sase core pin, not the TUI or the update toast.
- The node ID matches no existing task. The neighbouring `test_startup_update_toast_png_snapshot` flake (sase-19w) is a different node: a visual-lane timeout on notifications.
- Full logs and JUnit are kept in the phase evidence bundle file:explicit:cf0a3ec863e10c52c0785b78 (`primary-failure-classification.json`); summary in file:explicit:f8fc12f54cb3f9b647451035.
